name: Data, Analytics & BI
short: Build trustworthy data foundations, dashboards and forecasts people can use.
headline: Replace scattered reporting with a clearer view of performance.
problem: When information is inconsistent, duplicated or hard to reach, decisions rely on manual work and conflicting reports. A dashboard alone cannot fix unclear definitions or unreliable inputs. We help establish sound data foundations, useful measures and repeatable analysis.
whoFor: Teams reconciling conflicting reports from several systems
Leaders who need a dependable view of key measures
Organisations preparing to migrate or clean up data
Analysts wanting a repeatable forecasting or reporting workflow

offers.name: Data Readiness Check
offers.summary: A practical assessment of your data landscape and the steps needed for reliable analysis.

offers.name: Data Cleanup & Migration
offers.summary: A controlled process for preparing and moving agreed data to its new home.

offers.name: KPI Dashboard Build
offers.summary: A decision-focused dashboard with agreed measures, definitions and sources.

offers.name: Forecasting Models
offers.summary: A documented forecasting approach shaped around your data and planning decisions.

offers.name: Analytics as a Service
offers.summary: Ongoing analytical support to keep reporting clear and decisions grounded in evidence.

faqs.q: Do we need a data warehouse?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. We recommend an approach suited to the decisions you need to support and the systems you already have.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing BI tools?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with suitable tools already in use where practical, such as Looker Studio or Power BI.

faqs.q: Can you work with incomplete data?
faqs.a: Often, yes. We identify limitations, handle exceptions transparently and recommend improvements.

name: Knowledge, Document AI & Localization
short: Make organisational knowledge, document-heavy work and multilingual content easier to manage.
headline: Help people find trusted answers and move documents through work.
problem: Useful knowledge is often buried across files, systems and individual expertise. Manual document handling creates delays, inconsistent outputs and difficult hand-offs. We design practical workflows that make information easier to find, process, translate and maintain.
whoFor: Teams searching many repositories for reliable answers
Operations groups handling recurring document workflows
Process owners who need clear, usable procedures
Organisations preparing content for new languages and audiences

offers.name: Document Workflow Review
offers.summary: A review of document handling that identifies friction, risks and improvements.

offers.name: Company Knowledge Assistant
offers.summary: A grounded assistant that helps people find answers in approved organisational material.

offers.name: Document Processing Pipeline (invoices, contracts, forms)
offers.summary: A documented workflow to extract and route information from agreed document types.

offers.name: Process & SOP Sprint
offers.summary: Clear, practical process documentation that makes recurring work easier to follow.

offers.name: Localization (documents, websites, courses)
offers.summary: Adapted content that keeps its meaning and works for its local audience.

offers.name: Knowledge Upkeep
offers.summary: A recurring service that keeps selected knowledge resources accurate and useful.

faqs.q: Can an assistant answer only from approved material?
faqs.a: Yes. We configure it to use selected sources, provide references and test it on representative questions.

faqs.q: Can document processing include human review?
faqs.a: Yes. Review and exception steps are built in wherever judgement or verification is needed.

faqs.q: Do you provide certified translations?
faqs.a: Localization is not a substitute for certified translation. We help identify where formal certification is required.

name: Web, Apps & No-code Products
short: Design and launch websites, portals, internal tools and MVPs without unnecessary complexity.
headline: Create digital products that solve a real user need.
problem: A weak web experience makes it hard for visitors to understand what you offer or take the next step. Internal teams also lose time when everyday work relies on disconnected tools and spreadsheets. We shape, build and maintain digital solutions around clear user needs.
whoFor: Teams whose website no longer supports their goals
Organisations launching a new service or digital experience
Operators replacing spreadsheet-based workflows
Businesses needing a secure portal for customers

offers.name: Website Teardown
offers.summary: An expert review of your website with a prioritised set of practical improvements.

offers.name: AI-built Website
offers.summary: A human-directed website build that uses AI-assisted workflows where they add value.

offers.name: Landing Page Sprint
offers.summary: A focused landing page that explains an offer and guides visitors to act.

offers.name: Internal Tool or MVP
offers.summary: A working first version of a digital tool built around a validated workflow or need.

offers.name: Customer Portal
offers.summary: A customer-facing portal that brings selected information and tasks into one place.

offers.name: Site Care
offers.summary: Ongoing website maintenance and improvement to keep your site dependable.
includes: Small agreed content or usability changes

faqs.q: Do you work with our existing website platform?
faqs.a: We assess the platform first, then recommend whether to improve, extend or replace it.

faqs.q: Can we edit the site after handover?
faqs.a: Yes. We document the editing workflow and hand over in a way that suits your chosen platform.

faqs.q: Does an internal tool need to be fully specified first?
faqs.a: No. Discovery and prototyping clarify the need and shape a sensible first version.

name: Cloud, Workplace & IT Modernization
short: Make everyday tools, cloud services and IT support work together reliably.
headline: A dependable digital workplace starts with the right foundations.
problem: Disconnected tools, unclear access and ageing systems make routine work harder and create avoidable risk. We help you choose, configure and maintain practical workplace and cloud services, with a clear plan for adoption and support.
whoFor: Teams reviewing workplace tools and subscriptions
Organisations moving files or services to the cloud
Leaders planning a Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace rollout
Operations leads seeking dependable IT support

offers.name: Workplace Tools Review
offers.summary: A focused review of workplace tools, workflows and support needs with a prioritised plan.

offers.name: Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace Setup
offers.summary: A collaborative workspace configured around your organisation's needs.

offers.name: Copilot & Gemini Rollout
offers.summary: Prepare your environment and people to adopt Copilot or Gemini with sensible controls.

offers.name: Cloud Migration Planning
offers.summary: Turn cloud migration goals into a sequenced plan with dependencies and safeguards.

offers.name: IT Care
offers.summary: Consistent help maintaining workplace systems and resolving day-to-day issues.

faqs.q: Which workplace platforms do you support?
faqs.a: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and connected cloud services, based on your environment and requirements.

faqs.q: Can you work with our current IT provider?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate with your provider, clarify responsibilities and document decisions.

faqs.q: Will a setup interrupt normal work?
faqs.a: We plan changes around your operations, agree communications and schedule any transition steps with you.

name: Cybersecurity & Data Privacy Readiness
short: Improve security and privacy practices with clear, actionable readiness work.
headline: Build confidence in how your organisation protects information.
problem: Security expectations evolve while systems, suppliers and data practices change. Gaps in ownership or documentation make it hard to respond with confidence. We map practical priorities, strengthen everyday controls and prepare clear evidence, without presenting readiness work as a certified audit.
whoFor: Leaders seeking a practical view of security fundamentals
Teams preparing privacy processes for review
Organisations assessing safeguards for AI use
Operations owners updating policies and awareness materials
note: Readiness work delivered with certified partners, not a certified audit.

offers.name: Security Basics Check
offers.summary: A practical review of core security practices with a prioritised action list.

offers.name: Data Privacy Readiness (GDPR, India DPDP)
offers.summary: Organise privacy processes and documentation around the personal data you handle.

offers.name: AI Security Review
offers.summary: Review safeguards around selected AI tools, data flows and use cases.

offers.name: Policy & Training Pack
offers.summary: Usable security policies and practical awareness materials for your team.

offers.name: Quarterly Security Review
offers.summary: Recurring reviews that keep security priorities, actions and incidents visible.
includes: Refreshed risk register and next steps

faqs.q: Is this a certified security audit?
faqs.a: No. This is readiness and operational support, not a certified audit or formal assurance opinion.

faqs.q: Do you provide legal advice?
faqs.a: No. We organise practical privacy readiness and recommend qualified counsel for legal interpretation.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing security team?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate with internal owners and external providers so recommendations fit your environment.

name: People, HR & Change
short: Help people build confidence, capability and good habits around AI and change.
headline: Tools don't transform organisations. People do.
problem: New tools and processes deliver little when people are unsure how to use them or what good practice looks like. Leaders need practical ways to guide adoption, build capability and respond to concerns. We provide role-relevant learning and change support grounded in real work.
whoFor: Teams adopting AI in everyday work
Leaders shaping an organisation-wide change
People teams improving recruiting or onboarding
Managers wanting consistent guidance and learning paths

offers.name: Team AI Bootcamp
offers.summary: A hands-on session that helps people use AI thoughtfully on their real tasks.

offers.name: Leadership AI Workshop
offers.summary: Help leaders align on AI opportunities, risks and practical next steps.

offers.name: Competitive Intelligence Workshop
offers.summary: Equip a team to gather, interpret and apply competitive signals responsibly.

offers.name: HR Workflow Automation (recruiting, onboarding)
offers.summary: Design and implement a focused automation for a recruiting or onboarding workflow.

offers.name: Change Management Support
offers.summary: Keep momentum through clear communications, feedback and adoption support.

offers.name: AI Academy (self-paced)
offers.summary: A structured self-paced learning path for practical and responsible AI use.

offers.name: Monthly AI Clinic
offers.summary: A recurring forum to solve questions and practise useful AI approaches.

faqs.q: Can sessions be tailored to our work?
faqs.a: Yes. We shape examples around the roles, workflows and tools you identify.

faqs.q: Are sessions live or self-paced?
faqs.a: The Bootcamp and workshops are live; the AI Academy is self-paced.

faqs.q: Can you support change after a workshop?
faqs.a: Yes. Change Management Support and monthly clinics turn first learning into lasting practice.

name: Governance, Risk, ESG & Compliance
short: Create practical oversight for AI, continuity and responsible business commitments.
headline: Make responsible governance a foundation for progress.
problem: AI use and business commitments can grow faster than policies, ownership and review processes. Without a clear register and workable controls, teams struggle to explain decisions or respond to new expectations such as the EU AI Act. We establish practical readiness and reporting routines, not legal advice.
whoFor: Leaders establishing oversight for AI use
Teams preparing for new governance expectations
Organisations documenting ESG and continuity practices
Owners wanting a repeatable review cadence

offers.name: AI Policy & Use Register
offers.summary: A practical baseline of AI use and the policies needed to guide it.

offers.name: ESG & Continuity Readiness Check
offers.summary: Review ESG and continuity practices and identify useful next steps.

offers.name: AI Governance & EU AI Act Readiness
offers.summary: An AI governance baseline and readiness plan aligned to relevant obligations.

offers.name: ESG Narrative Reporting
offers.summary: Turn verified information into clear, consistent ESG narrative updates.

offers.name: Quarterly Governance Review
offers.summary: Keep governance records, actions and reviews current as practices evolve.

faqs.q: Is this legal advice?
faqs.a: No. This is readiness and governance support, not legal advice. Consult qualified counsel for legal interpretation.

faqs.q: Do you certify compliance?
faqs.a: No. We document practices, identify readiness gaps and plan actions; we do not certify compliance.

faqs.q: Which EU AI Act dates matter now?
faqs.a: AI-literacy duties already apply, Article 50 transparency rules took effect on 2 August 2026, and stand-alone high-risk obligations start on 2 December 2027.

name: Operations, Finance & Supply Chain
short: Make back-office, finance and supply-chain workflows clearer, connected and easier to manage.
headline: Reliable operations turn everyday information into better decisions.
problem: Manual hand-offs, scattered records and delayed reporting make it hard to see what needs attention. Finance and supply-chain work often depends on repetitive coordination that can be streamlined without losing oversight. We map the work, improve the flow and build useful visibility around it.
whoFor: Finance teams handling recurring documents and approvals
Operations leads seeking clear process ownership
Procurement teams coordinating suppliers and requests
Decision-makers who need timely inventory or logistics visibility

offers.name: Back-office Automation Audit
offers.summary: Identify automation opportunities across selected back-office processes.

offers.name: Finance Ops Automation (invoices, payables, reporting)
offers.summary: Automate a defined finance workflow with clear checks and human approvals.

offers.name: Procurement & Supplier Automation
offers.summary: Streamline procurement or supplier processes with traceable steps and ownership.

offers.name: Inventory & Logistics Dashboards
offers.summary: Bring inventory and logistics information into a practical operational dashboard.

offers.name: Ops Care
offers.summary: Maintain and improve selected workflows, reporting and automation over time.

faqs.q: Will automation remove human checks?
faqs.a: No. Approval points and exception handling keep appropriate human oversight.

faqs.q: What if our data is inconsistent?
faqs.a: We identify data issues during discovery and include validation or cleanup steps in the scope.

faqs.q: Can you start with one workflow?
faqs.a: Yes. One focused process is often the best way to set requirements, controls and a pattern to reuse.
